alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the historic center of Cambados at night, with the Torre de San Sadurniño surviving as two high jagged granite wall fragments on the A Figueira islet and the pazos along the ría behind.
description: From the quay at night, the Torre de San Sadurniño on the A Figueira islet is only two high jagged granite wall fragments meeting at a broken corner. It is not an intact hollow square tower. Across the dark ría, the granite pazos of Cambados show a few warm windows.
